name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
history: One of the most revered Shiva temples in India, Kashi Vishwanath stands in Varanasi near the Ganga and is closely associated with the spiritual identity of the ancient city.
significance: The temple is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas and is considered a major destination for Shaiva pilgrimage.
darshanTimings: 3:00 AM - 11:00 PM. Timings may change on festival days.

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
history: The Madurai temple complex is known for its towering gopurams, sculptural heritage, and deep connection with the cultural history of the Pandya region.
significance: Dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi and Lord Sundareswarar, it is a major center of Shakti worship and Dravidian architecture.

name: Jagannath Temple
history: The Puri temple is one of India's most important pilgrimage centers and has been central to Odisha's ritual, artistic, and devotional traditions for centuries.
significance: It is one of the Char Dham sites and is famous for the annual Rath Yatra of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra.
darshanTimings: 5:30 AM - 10:00 PM, with intervals for rituals and bhoga.

name: Somnath Temple
history: Somnath is celebrated in tradition as an ancient seat of Shiva worship on the western coast of India and has been restored multiple times across history.
significance: It is revered as the first among the twelve Jyotirlingas and is a key heritage destination in Gujarat.
guidelines: Photography is restricted in temple zones

name: Kamakhya Temple
history: Located on Nilachal Hill, Kamakhya Temple is a major Shakti shrine with a layered history of Tantra, regional devotion, and Assamese temple culture.
significance: It is among the most important Shakti Peethas and draws pilgrims from across India.

name: Sri Venkateswara Temple
history: The Tirumala hill shrine is one of India's most visited pilgrimage destinations and has a long tradition of royal patronage, music, ritual, and community service.
significance: Dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, the temple is a central Vaishnava pilgrimage site.
darshanTimings: Darshan schedules vary by ticket type and daily temple operations.
guidelines: Book official darshan slots where applicable
